headlines.headline: July CPI 0.1% MoM, 3.4% YoY — Trims September Hike Odds to ~42%
headlines.driver: For TLT: Positive — cool CPI cut hike odds 20pp and lifted TLT; shows TLT's high beta to CPI — single print moves TLT 1-2% vs SHY 0.2%.

headlines.headline: July PPI Flat MoM — Core Goods Disinflation Helps Doubt Hike Case
headlines.driver: For TLT: Positive — flat PPI reinforced 'Fed can stay patient' and pushed hike odds to low 30s, directly supporting TLT's duration bid into Jackson Hole.
